<progress value="32" max="100">32%</progress>
<style>
  progress { width: 100%; height: 16px; -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; border: 0; }
  progress::-webkit-progress-bar { background: #eee; border-radius: 8px; }
  progress::-webkit-progress-value { background: {{fill_color}}; border-radius: 8px; transition: width .3s; }
  progress::-moz-progress-bar { background: {{fill_color}}; border-radius: 8px; }
</style>
